description: Image Description: The image is a black and white representation of a handwritten digit. The digit '4' is centered in the image and is written in white against a black background. The strokes of the digit are clear and distinct, with a vertical line on the left and a horizontal line extending from the middle of the vertical line to the right, forming the top of the '4'. The bottom right part forms an angled line connecting to the vertical line. The style is typical of a handwritten numeral.
